stories.title: FIFA confirms UK as 2035 Women’s World Cup host, with Wrexham and Cardiff in the Welsh bid
stories.summary: Wrexham’s Racecourse is one of three Welsh stadiums in line to host matches at the 2035 FIFA Women’s World Cup, after the UK was confirmed as host of the tournament today. stories.title: Connah’s Quay darts and pool centre set to open on Dock Road next week
stories.summary: A family darts and pool centre in Deeside is taking shape ahead of its official opening next week. Ellis’ Darts is a brand-new facility on Dock Road in Connah’s Quay offering tournament grade darts and pool facilities aimed at the region’s youth. stories.title: Polaris Ranger stolen from Sychdyn farm found in Garden City
stories.summary: Police are trying to trace a small white car seen travelling with a Polaris Ranger stolen from a farm in the Sychdyn area of Flintshire. stories.title: Menai Suspension Bridge repairs delayed until autumn 2027 after water found in steelwork
stories.summary: The Welsh Government deputy transport minister has expressed his “extreme disappointment and frustration” after further delays to historic bridge works were announced. stories.title: Teenager charged with 20 offences after thefts from cars across Flintshire and Wrexham
stories.summary: A 16-year-old has been charged with 20 offences, including thefts from cars, reported across Flintshire and Wrexham. North Wales Police said the offences were reported between August and September. The charges include nine counts of theft from a motor vehicle and four counts of vehicle interference.
